units.source_text: 我吃力地支撑着他的视线的力量。

en.t: I struggled to withstand the force of his gaze.

units.source_text: 但一想到他那种对"毁灭性"的理解与我的志向背反甚远，我就又恢复了平静。

en.t: But when I thought how far his understanding of "destructiveness" ran counter to my own aspirations, I regained my calm.

units.source_text: 我的回答丝毫也不结巴了。

en.t: My answer no longer faltered in the slightest.
